PSS_scope: Same all-eligible-phase per-run maximum and three-observed-run range; CPU/disk unknown never filters PSS samples. Complete-cohort hard failure forbids success, rather than selecting favorable observations.
execution_scope: Static AST, source comparisons and CLI help only. No actual archive audit, mock scientific data, producer import, GPU, network, YT, staging, launch or publication.

prior_capsule.scope: Whole SHA/local-preservation receipt only. No expansion, old timing reads/pooling, recovered partial job metrics or OS-exit0 claim.

required_inputs: Genuine completed ENVv4 raw archive, root-independent whole SHA and fresh output path. No extraction/recorded-path opening.
storage_scope: Original/nested actual admission; Bound PVC UID/volumeName + Pod subPath/mount/device/owned-file probes; direct PV claimRef was not visible. Runtime4GiB/positive exposed inodes separate from initial80GiB/64K admission. Recorded byte thresholds checked; raw statvfs block arithmetic not serialized. Latest inventory is sampled/non-atomic; no capacity reservation or continuous/global health claim.
